pages.text: Crafted at a crafting table from Mystery Ingots, Lapis Lazuli, Diamonds, an Enchanting Table and Obsidian. When placed it is a broken altar with a pale blue circle floating in its middle.

$(l)Right-click it with a Nether Star$() to activate it. The altar mends itself where it stands: the star rises into a white orb, five white circles unfold one after another, and a beam of light shoots into the sky as the $(l)guardian barrier$() deploys.$(br2)The barrier covers the $(l)3×3 chunks$() around the altar's chunk, from bedrock up to y=255.

Inside the barrier:$(li)hostile mobs perish and do not spawn naturally$(li)players keep Regeneration and Saturation$(li)bosses do not perish, but are thrown out of the barrier, and their attacks, spells and explosions are blocked$(br2)Barriers cannot overlap (altars must be at least 3 chunks apart).$(br)Breaking the altar removes the barrier, and the Nether Star $(l)withers$() with it.
